scripts.dev: npm run build -w @supplypilot/contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web "npm run dev -w @supplypilot/contracts" "npm run dev -w @supplypilot/api" "npm run dev -w @supplypilot/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @supplypilot/contracts && npm run build -w @supplypilot/api && npm run build -w @supplypilot/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @supplypilot/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p tests/e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w @supplypilot/contracts && vitest run && vitest run --config apps/web/vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:db: npm run build -w @supplypilot/contracts && npm run test:db -w @supplypilot/api
scripts.test:web: npm run build -w @supplypilot/contracts && vitest run --config apps/web/vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w @supplypilot/contracts && npm run test:e2e -w @supplypilot/api
scripts.test:rag: npm run build -w @supplypilot/contracts && npm run test:rag -w @supplypilot/api
scripts.smoke:agents: npm run build -w @supplypilot/contracts && npm run smoke:agents -w @supplypilot/api
scripts.smoke:intents: npm run build -w @supplypilot/contracts && npm run smoke:intents -w @supplypilot/api
